every_position_composed.reason: In frame 4, the second site hides the text panel completely so the anchor rack on the left is unobstructed, whereas the first site leaves a dark translucent card blocking that 3D machine.

explains_the_project.reason: Both sites use the exact same 3D factory metaphor across frames 1 to 9 to clearly illustrate token floods, the digest press, anchor racks, and seven host lanes.

craft_of_the_3d.reason: Both sites feature the identical well-crafted 3D scene with grounded dark-metal machinery, edge highlights, and shadows across all nine frames.

type_and_layout.reason: In frames 4 and 7, the second site cleanly removes the text overlay during camera transitions, avoiding the dim, unreadable ghosted text cards visible in frames 4 and 7 of the first site.

overall.reason: While both sites share the same strong 3D visualization and design, the second site handles scroll transitions much more cleanly by hiding text cards in frames 4 and 7 instead of leaving murky, unreadable boxes over the 3D scene.
